/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'JS'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
const response = await fetch('http://localhost:3100/admin')
const html = await response.text()
assert.equal(response.status, 403)
assert.match(html, /403 Forbidden/)
assert.match(html, /Access restricted/)
assert.match(html, /Back to home/)
assert.doesNotMatch(html, /You have administrator access/)
const stylesheet = html.match(/href=\"(["'^"]+'"\\.css["'^'"\\\"]*)\"/)
assert.ok(stylesheet, 'The error page includes its stylesheet')
const css = await fetch(new URL(stylesheet[1].replaceAll('&', '&'), response.url))
assert.equal(css.status, 200)
assert.match(await css.text(), /place-items:center/)
const home = await fetch('http://localhost:3100/')
assert.equal(home.status, 200)
console.log('Production HTTP checks passed: /admin returns 403 with styled forbidden page; / returns 200.')
JS
"
